guides.summary: Registered OAuth client required. Your personal Asana sign-in is independent of gateway. A URL-only registration cannot authenticate.

steps.title: Create an Asana MCP app
steps.description: Sign in with your personal account; create an app of type MCP app. Keep its Client ID and Client Secret private.

steps.title: Allow your workspace
steps.description: Manage distribution → Specific workspaces → select your personal workspace.

steps.title: Configure client and callback
steps.description: Claude Code supports client ID/secret pre-registration. Desktop needs a compatible OAuth configuration or local bridge. Register exactly the callback used by that client; do not reuse Anthropic or gateway callbacks.

steps.title: Authorize your personal account
steps.description: Complete browser consent only after client credentials and callback are configured. This app currently registers the endpoint; it does not provision the OAuth client.

guides.summary: No automatic client registration. Requires a registered Slack app or a supported partner client.

steps.title: Choose the authentication route
steps.description: Partner integrations and custom internal apps have different setup flows. The hosted Claude integration is not automatically inherited by a gateway Desktop profile.

steps.title: Register a Slack app
steps.description: Custom clients need an internal or Marketplace-published app. Unlisted apps cannot use Slack MCP.

steps.title: Set OAuth permissions and callback
steps.description: Configure user scopes for the tools you need, app credentials, and the exact callback used by the client. Workspace approval may be required.

steps.title: Authorize the workspace
steps.description: Sign in to the desired workspace. A server URL alone does not supply the registered OAuth application.

guides.summary: Hosted Notion MCP uses interactive OAuth. Select the workspace and pages you want to share.

steps.title: Review Notion setup
steps.description: Use the official hosted server and a client with remote OAuth support.

steps.title: Select your workspace and pages
steps.description: During authorization, select the intended account/workspace and permitted content.

steps.title: Connect and test
steps.description: After registration, authorize in your client and test access to a shared page.

guides.summary: OAuth with automatic client registration is supported. API-key authentication is an alternative.

steps.title: Review setup and permissions
steps.description: Read-only endpoint /mcp/readonly is available. Default /mcp permits read/write.

steps.title: Authorize the intended workspace
steps.description: Use client OAuth sign-in. Separate workspace connections need separate authentication contexts.

guides.summary: Rovo supports browser OAuth. Site access and organization policies apply.

steps.title: Check your Atlassian site
steps.description: Ensure your account can access the Jira/Confluence resources you need.

steps.title: Review administrator controls
steps.description: Some tools require enabled permission groups. API-token authentication requires admin enablement.

steps.title: Authorize in your client
steps.description: Complete browser consent using the intended Atlassian account.

guides.summary: Remote Figma MCP requires Figma sign-in; tool limits depend on plan and seat.

steps.title: Check plan and client support
steps.description: Review current eligibility, usage limits, and supported remote clients.

steps.title: Authorize your Figma account
steps.description: Complete OAuth in the MCP client. Access follows your file permissions.

guides.summary: Choose the monday.com authentication route appropriate for your client.

steps.title: Choose personal or public integration
steps.description: Personal API token and public OAuth integration have different prerequisites.

steps.title: Review OAuth registration
steps.description: Public integrations use the documented client registration process.

steps.title: Personal-token alternative
steps.description: Follow the personal API-token guide; do not put tokens in arbitrary headers or paste them into chat.

guides.summary: HubSpot requires OAuth with PKCE. Confirm the endpoint and supported client route.

steps.title: Review hosted MCP requirements
steps.description: The catalog endpoint is an Anthropic integration route; do not assume it supports every local client.

steps.title: Authorize the intended HubSpot account
steps.description: Confirm account permissions and requested access before granting consent.

guides.summary: Hosted Anthropic connector and independent local Microsoft Graph server are different integrations.

steps.title: Review hosted connector requirements
steps.description: Check supported accounts, tenant consent, and the official connector setup.

steps.title: Check Desktop callback compatibility
steps.description: Hosted connector setup does not establish that a gateway local client can use Anthropic OAuth credentials. Client registration and callback must be compatible.

steps.title: Consider the local alternative
steps.description: Select Local alternative in this app for Softeria’s independent device-code server; Node/npx and tenant approval may be required.

guides.summary: Google Workspace MCP is a Developer Preview with Cloud-project and OAuth prerequisites.

steps.title: Check preview eligibility
steps.description: Membership in the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program is required.

steps.title: Configure your Cloud project
steps.description: Enable the relevant APIs and configure OAuth branding, audience and data access.

steps.title: Create client credentials
steps.description: Follow the documented client type and callback requirements; managed Workspace policies may apply.
